footnote_text: Represents performance share units ("PSUs") that vested based on the appreciation in the share price of Hamilton Insurance Group, Ltd. (the "Company") relative to the share price established following the Company's initial public offering. The award provided for a maximum of 250,000 PSUs, with the number of PSUs vesting based on the percentage increase from the average closing share price over the 30-trading-day period following the initial public offering to the average closing share price over the 30-trading-day period ending on the vesting date. The maximum 250,000 PSUs would vest upon a 100% or greater increase in the Company's share price over the applicable measurement period. || Includes restricted stock units.

Represents shares withheld to satisfy tax obligations arising out of the vesting of the reporting person's  PSUs. || Represents the closing price per share on November 9, 2026, used to determine the number of shares to be withheld by the issuer to satisfy tax withholding obligations. || Includes restricted stock units.

Represents shares withheld to satisfy tax obligations arising out of the vesting of the reporting person's restricted stock units. || Represents the closing price per share on November 9, 2026, used to determine the number of shares to be withheld by the issuer to satisfy tax withholding obligations. || Includes restricted stock units.
